name: Yaroslav Korets
role: Founder / proposed operating and technology lead, Accounting Growth Partners

pilot.statusSource: Founder update supplied for publication in AGP materials, October 12, 2026
pilot.publicDescription: We are currently working on an operations pilot for Black Inc Tax Services. The pilot is intended to test the proposed operating approach in a real firm before broader replication.
pilot.scopeSourceStatus: Published 30-day pilot proposal; describes intended deliverables, not completed outcomes. Current activity is confirmed separately by the founder.
scope: Create a shared client-and-tax-year record with source-linked facts and case status.
Select one repeated operational bottleneck with the firm and test a bounded workflow.
Keep existing practice and tax software; professionals retain tax judgment and filing.
Track time by role, turnaround, rework, reviewer acceptance, adoption and recurring delivery cost.
pilot.commercialTerms: Not disclosed in this packet; no paid invoice, agreed price or acquisition commitment is inferred.
nextEvidence: Agreed cohort, scope and baseline with measurement confidence.
Before/after time including reviewer effort, exceptions and fallback work.
Professional acceptance and downstream quality for the selected process.
Full recurring cost and a documented use for freed capacity.
A go, fix, hold or stop decision and the conditions for repeating the deployment.
pilot.economicRule: Count verified cost removed or incremental contribution from accepted additional work, subtract added technology/support/review costs, and avoid counting the same freed hour twice. Capacity alone is not cash savings.
pilot.privacy: Only the public scope and founder-authorized status are included. No taxpayer data, private client records or contracts.
